title: Per-exam solve cache keyed by pinned model ID + prompt hash + data hash, already-solved confirm (REQ-0089)

AC2 unpinned model alias rejected for --real
AC3 already-solved exam asks confirm or needs --yes/--fresh; no TTY refuses

design.summary: Per-exam solve cache in Runner.call reusing ReplyCache (key = pinned model + prompt sha + image shas); model_pins alias rejection for --real; already-solved check via plans/<exam-id>/*/plan.json with --yes/--fresh, no-TTY refuses; trace/metrics cached+saved; mock tests then small-exam paid proof

implementation.summary: Runner.call per-exam ReplyCache (ns solve), claude.pinned + model_pins (--real only), plans/<exam-id>/cache, planrun.last_solved + --fresh/--yes, cached/cost_saved in result/plan/index/metrics
